description_en: Queries the details of a trace
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-trace --trace-id ac14001a15954493811405707d0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 1623827602000 --end-time 1623827603000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrace

parameters.help_en: The trace ID. You can log on to the ARMS console and obtain the trace ID on the **Trace Query** page or **Interface Snapshot** tab
parameters.help_zh: 调用链ID。可在ARMS控制台的**调用链路查询**页面或**接口快照**页面获取
parameters.name: trace_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the ID of the trace is 30 characters in length, this parameter is optional. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
>若TraceID长度为30，可不填；若TraceID长度不是30，则必填
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the ID of the trace is 30 characters in length, this parameter is optional. Otherwise, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
>若TraceID长度为30，可不填；若TraceID长度不是30，则必填
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries on each page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 查询分页的每页项目数量，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size
